target_customer: Non-technical individuals and small teams who want to build web apps without coding
problem: Building a web app requires coding skill, so ideas for personal software never ship.
business_model: Subscription for an AI app builder with usage costs

founders.name: Nicholas Charriere
founders.background_notes: 12 years as a developer in the Valley.

exit.reason: Founders announced sunset after two years; secondary sources cite inability to raise and high user acquisition and AI token costs

technical_complexity.rationale: Code generation agent with hosting, database and auth is standard engineering for experienced engineers, with hard parts in reliability and cost.

defensibility.rationale: Prompt to app builders were easily replicated and relied on third party models.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: By 2025 funded rivals including Bolt and Lovable dominated the category per a 2025 profile.

market_need_then: Interest in AI coding rose quickly in 2023 to 2025, but sustained paying demand and margins proved hard.

branding.name_origin: Rebranded from Srcbook; reason given in a Mocha blog post that could not be fetched

rebrands.why: Pivot from developer notebook to AI app builder for everyone; per directory and Mocha blog title

branding.community_and_virality: Srcbook featured on Hacker News in August 2024

brand_strength.rationale: Name is a common word shared with many products and coffee, so search confusion is likely, though no source quantifies it.

pivots.from: Srcbook, open-source TypeScript notebook for AI assisted prototyping
pivots.to: Mocha, AI no-code web app builder
pivots.why: Aim to serve everyone, not only developers

outcome_analysis: Mocha started as the Srcbook developer tool, pivoted to a no-code AI app builder in mid 2025 and announced a shutdown for August 1 2026. Secondary sources say user acquisition was expensive, AI token costs hurt margins and the founders could not raise more capital, while funded rivals like Bolt and Lovable led the category. The YC directory labels it Acquired but no acquirer exists in any source found.
notes: YC status Acquired conflicts with shutdown reports; no acquirer named anywhere. A profile claims $2.1M raised in 2025, single unverified source, not recorded. Shutdown reasons come from secondary sites, official post not fetched (blog host blocked, seedtable 403 on later fetch). Competitors in 2023 not sourced with dates; Bolt and Lovable evidence is from 2025, so list empty. Seed added: Seedtable lists a seed dated 2023-09-01 from Y Combinator and Soma Capital with no amount (amount null). EveryDev says $500,000 in 2023-08 from YC only; low-reliability aggregators claim $2.1M or $6M; none are recorded.
